speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sit. The king was Thursday, and you have not told it. I will have the plot with the mutton. Take the soft side. Threepence the dinner.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A king comes home from his wars. He takes a cousin's land. The cousin comes home and takes the crown. That is the plot, Mistress, and it is shorter than the play.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And is the cousin punished?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not in the play.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then I don't call that a play, I call it a bad example.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The town called it the king play. Thursday's box held eleven pound six. Forty-five shillings, my share. It is in the book. I am not counting the box again, and I am not turning the two into one sum.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Thursday is three days old, Master Shakespeare, and the king is played.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Last Sunday at this board you told me after Thursday. A shilling would walk forty yards down Bishopsgate Street to Master Yaxley.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He is played once, and he is to be played again on Tuesday. I am not going down Bishopsgate today. A duke who dies in the second act can afford a clove until the week has its king.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Last week it was Thursday. Now it is Tuesday. I am keeping the count of your delays, if you are not.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: A bad tooth that stays past its day takes rent of the whole head, Master Shakespeare. When a shuttle splinters, you do not weave the piece out with the splinter in the wool.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A shuttle does not have to speak the England speech before dinner, Master Verbeke. The soft end of the plate will do for today.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The loaf wants a full thumb of the notch. Mistress measured it on the board before you sat.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A penny the loaf, and a full thumb short, and I will not call it two fingers to please a baker. Mark me. The notch was cut in a better year.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A penny, then. I am not arguing the notch.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Threepence the meal, as ever. Tomorrow is Monday. The sixpence for firing and washing begins in silver, and it has not been paid.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sixpence in the morning, before I go. I must be at Shoreditch by nine. At two the old Roman is done by the fourth act, and the jaw may have the passage after.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Monday I take the shuttle to Norton Folgate. The loom does not keep Sunday in its feet, but I do. The shuttle goes, and comes, and goes.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then be hungry at a penny loaf and a threepence board, and leave the king in Shoreditch. I have the plot. The cousin is not punished. I do not need the fifth act.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Was the king a boy, sir?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The king was a man. I was the old man who was already gone.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Feel the jaw quietly. I heard the boards on Thursday. I do not require a second performance in my ceiling.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: After nine I will be dull. The girl in the third act can wait until there is a morning. I have no new sheet in me today.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Gib, off the loaf. It is a thumb short without your help, and you are not a sharer.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let him look. He has no forty-five shillings, and he takes nothing from the bad side of the plate.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sixpence in the morning, in my hand, not by the inkhorn. And leave Master Yaxley until you mean to walk the forty yards. Eat, before the soft side goes cold.
